78.translation: Indeed, because in passages such as ‘O Pārtha, that Supreme Person is attainable by exclusive devotion’ and ‘by exclusive devotion, O Arjuna, I can be known in this form,’ devotion to the Blessed Lord is heard to be the most effective means toward liberation, it is clearly understood that exclusive devotion to Him alone, furnished merely with the intermediate operation of knowledge arising from His grace, is the cause of liberation. It is proper that knowledge be an intermediate operation of devotion. From statements such as ‘to those who are constantly joined, who worship Me with love, I give that yoga of understanding by which they come to Me’ and ‘My devotee, knowing this, becomes fit for My state,’ it has been said that knowledge of reality itself is devotion. In passages such as ‘equal toward all beings, he obtains supreme devotion to Me’ and ‘through devotion he knows Me in truth, how great I am and who I am,’ they are designated separately. Nor, if this is so, should contradiction with Śruti passages such as ‘knowing Him alone, one crosses beyond death; there is no other path for going’ be suspected, because knowledge is an intermediate operation of devotion. When it is said ‘he cooks with pieces of wood,’ it is not thereby said that the flames are not a means.
word_for_word: tathā hi puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyaḥ tu ananyayā
indeed, ‘O Pārtha, that Supreme Person is attainable by exclusive devotion’
bhaktyā tu ananyayā śakyaḥ aham evaṃ-vidhaḥ arjuna ity-ādau
and ‘by exclusive devotion, O Arjuna, I can be known in this form,’ and so forth
because devotion to the Blessed Lord is heard to be the most effective means toward liberation
tad-ekānta-bhaktiḥ eva tat-prasāda-uttha-jñāna-avāntara-vyāpāra-mātra-yuktā mokṣa-hetuḥ iti sphuṭaṃ pratīyate
it is clearly understood that exclusive devotion to Him alone, furnished merely with the intermediate operation of knowledge arising from His grace, is the cause of liberation
it is proper that knowledge be an intermediate operation of devotion
teṣāṃ satata-yuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prīti-pūrvakam dadāmi buddhi-yogaṃ taṃ yena mām upayānti
